page.overview:
What is Unspace?

Unspace is an extra-dimensional location in the fictional universe of Transformers by Hasbro and Takara Tomy.

Unspace is a realm of kaleidoscopic madness and anti-matter, a timeless non-space that exists beyond all reality. Cybertronians often use space bridges to travel through unspace as a means of teleportation. Some entities, such as Unicron and other multiversal singularities, can transverse through unspace at will by using avatars.

It is also home to the Elder Gods, a race of ancient evil entities of indescribable power. If someone is unfortunate enough to be stranded in unspace, they will likely suffer a fate far worse than death at the hands of the Elder Gods. (: Hasbro Transformers Collectors' Club issue #5, Ramjet's profile) Despite being trapped in unspace, the Elder Gods were able to influence the minds of sensitive beings in the material universe, including H. P. Lovecraft, who used his horror prose to channel their call. Although the clandestine organisation, Oblivion, killed him before he could summon them, Lovecraft's stories continued to spread throughout popular culture and the Elder Gods eventually broke free to invade the multiverse. (: Infestation 2)
